$comment: Every public page, one record each: the only place its path, title, description, OG card, og:type, JSON-LD schema type and breadcrumb parent are written. SeoMeta and resources/og/cards.json derive from this; scripts/og reads it too. `non_pages` lists the GET routes that are not pages (endpoints and infrastructure) so tests derive that list here as well. Run the SEO tests after editing.
